newsitem.title: USA: Anesta says Actiq study shows pain relief.
newsitem.headline: Anesta says Actiq study shows pain relief.

text.p: Anesta Corp said on Tuesday that Actiq, a new product developed to control breakthrough pain in cancer patients, had provided better pain relief than previous medications in a company study.

The study, a subset of an Actiq new drug application submitted by Anesta to the FDA, found that the drug "provided better pain relief scores than patients' previous breakthrough pain medications," the company said in a statement.
Breakthrough pain occurs when episodes of moderate to severe pain "break through" a baseline of persistent pain.
Anesta is a pharmaceutical company that specializes in oral transmucosal drug delivery.
